Prague, Czech Republic, October 13 – 17, 2025 Agenda Item: 7 Document for: Discussion, Decision 1 Introduction This document is intended to facilitate the review process of the draft CR 38.211 for NR_newRAT-Core, TEI18. 2 Discussion – first round Please provide your comments on the latest version of the draft CR for 38.211 available in this folder. Editor’s response: The CR is a Rel-18 CR (not Rel-19). The WI code proposed by ZTE might be a better fit that the Rel-18 MIMO WI code. I will update the coverage page to “ NR_newRAT-Core, TEI18” The CR in R1-2508196 was indeed agreed. My understanding from the chairman’s notes is that the Rel-18 CR in R1-2508196 and the Rel-19 mirror in R1-2508197 were agreed and should be submitted as separate CRs (by CATT), hence they are not included in the a

Location of files: http://10.10.10.10/ftp/RAN/RAN1/Inbox/drafts/7(NR_uptoR17_Maint)/NR_NRN_references/draft_CR Note: The intention is that the draft CRs will be incorporated to the alignment CRs for the respective specifications. Update based on the Wednesday online session: Companies are encouraged to continue commenting on the draft CRs.
